cohort: 442 patients diagnosed with GDM at Unimed Hospital Center in Joinville from 2011 to 2017
finding: Obese pregnant women with GDM were approximately twice as likely to undergo cesarean section compared to non-obese women with GDM.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rates were higher in obese GDM patients (86.2%) compared to non-obese GDM patients (75.9%).
gest_age: Gestational age at GDM diagnosis was recorded
